content.text:
I don't have a record of Mira taking her first steps. The episodes I can see for her include stacking blocks, pulling to standing at the couch, and self-feeding — but nothing logged yet as independent walking.

If she has started walking, let me know and I'll save that milestone so it's on record. Otherwise, worth mentioning at her next pediatric visit with Riverdale if you're not seeing steps yet, just so it's tracked.
